CL SCR

SET DEFINE OFF;
SET SERVEROUTPUT ON FORMAT WRAPPED;

CREATE OR REPLACE PROCEDURE activate_vip_and_issue_perks (
    p_member_id      IN VARCHAR2,
    p_plan_id        IN VARCHAR2,
    p_payment_method IN VARCHAR2
) AS
    -- Member and Plan Details
    v_member_name     MEMBER.FullName%TYPE;
    v_plan_name       SUBSCRIPTIONPLAN.PlanName%TYPE;
    v_duration        SUBSCRIPTIONPLAN.DurationInDays%TYPE;
    v_price           SUBSCRIPTIONPLAN.Price%TYPE;

    -- State Check Variables
    v_active_count    NUMBER := 0;

    -- Auto-Generated IDs
    v_new_sub_id      SUBSCRIPTION.SubscriptionID%TYPE;
    v_new_pay_id      PAYMENT.PaymentID%TYPE;
    v_new_mv_id       MEMBERVOUCHER.MemberVoucherID%TYPE;

    -- Voucher Variables (NEW LOGIC)
    v_welcome_voucher_id   VOUCHER.VoucherID%TYPE;
    v_voucher_code         VOUCHER.VoucherCode%TYPE;
    v_has_received_welcome NUMBER := 0;
    v_voucher_issued       BOOLEAN := FALSE;

    -- Custom Exceptions
    e_already_vip     EXCEPTION;
    e_invalid_payment EXCEPTION;
    
BEGIN
    -- 1. Validate Payment Method constraint
    IF p_payment_method NOT IN ('Credit Card', 'Debit Card', 'E-Wallet', 'Cash') THEN
        RAISE e_invalid_payment;
    END IF;

    -- 2. Fetch Details & Validate Existence
    SELECT FullName INTO v_member_name FROM MEMBER WHERE MemberID = p_member_id;
    SELECT PlanName, DurationInDays, Price INTO v_plan_name, v_duration, v_price 
    FROM SUBSCRIPTIONPLAN WHERE SubscriptionPlanID = p_plan_id;

    -- 3. Security Check: Prevent double-subscription
    SELECT COUNT(*) INTO v_active_count 
    FROM SUBSCRIPTION 
    WHERE MemberID = p_member_id AND Status = 'Active';

    IF v_active_count > 0 THEN
        RAISE e_already_vip;
    END IF;

    -- 4. AUTO-GENERATE NEW PRIMARY KEYS
    SELECT 'S' || LPAD(NVL(MAX(TO_NUMBER(SUBSTR(SubscriptionID, 2))), 0) + 1, 5, '0')
    INTO v_new_sub_id FROM SUBSCRIPTION;

    v_new_pay_id := 'PM' || seq_payment_id.NEXTVAL;

    SELECT 'MV' || LPAD(NVL(MAX(TO_NUMBER(SUBSTR(MemberVoucherID, 3))), 0) + 1, 5, '0')
    INTO v_new_mv_id FROM MEMBERVOUCHER;

    -- 5. STRICT ONE-TIME WELCOME VOUCHER LOGIC (Targeting VT00015)

    -- Step 5a: Check if user has EVER received a Welcome Voucher (VT00015) in the past
    SELECT COUNT(*)
    INTO v_has_received_welcome
    FROM MEMBERVOUCHER MV
    JOIN VOUCHER V ON MV.VoucherID = V.VoucherID
    WHERE MV.MemberID = p_member_id
      AND V.VoucherTypeID = 'VT00015';

    -- Step 5b: If they never received it, explicitly find a VT00015 Voucher
    IF v_has_received_welcome = 0 THEN
        BEGIN
            SELECT VoucherID, VoucherCode INTO v_welcome_voucher_id, v_voucher_code
            FROM (
                SELECT VoucherID, VoucherCode
                FROM VOUCHER 
                WHERE VoucherTypeID = 'VT00015'
                ORDER BY VoucherID
            )
            WHERE ROWNUM = 1;
        EXCEPTION
            WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND THEN
                v_welcome_voucher_id := NULL; 
        END;
    END IF;

    -- 6. PERFORM MULTI-TABLE DATA MANIPULATION (DML)
    
    -- A. Create Subscription Record
    INSERT INTO SUBSCRIPTION (SubscriptionID, MemberID, SubscriptionPlanID, StartDate, EndDate, Status)
    VALUES (v_new_sub_id, p_member_id, p_plan_id, SYSDATE, SYSDATE + v_duration, 'Active');

    -- B. Create Payment Record
    INSERT INTO PAYMENT (PaymentID, OrderID, SubscriptionID, PaymentMethod, PaymentStatus)
    VALUES (v_new_pay_id, NULL, v_new_sub_id, p_payment_method, 'Completed');

    -- C. Issue Welcome Voucher ONLY if eligible and voucher exists
    IF v_has_received_welcome = 0 AND v_welcome_voucher_id IS NOT NULL THEN
        INSERT INTO MEMBERVOUCHER (MemberVoucherID, MemberID, VoucherID, DateClaimed, IsUsed)
        VALUES (v_new_mv_id, p_member_id, v_welcome_voucher_id, SYSDATE, 'N');
        v_voucher_issued := TRUE;
    END IF;

    COMMIT;

    -- 7. PRINT VIP WELCOME RECEIPT
    DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE('===================================================');
    DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE('        VIP SUBSCRIPTION ACTIVATED SUCCESSFULLY    ');
    DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE('===================================================');
    DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE('Member Name       : ' || v_member_name || ' (' || p_member_id || ')');
    DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE('Subscription ID   : ' || v_new_sub_id);
    DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE('Plan Selected     : ' || v_plan_name);
    DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE('Valid Until       : ' || TO_CHAR(SYSDATE + v_duration, 'DD-MON-YYYY'));
    DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE('---------------------------------------------------');
    DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE(RPAD('Amount Paid', 25) || ': RM ' || LPAD(TO_CHAR(v_price, '990.99'), 8));
    DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE(RPAD('Payment Method', 25) || ': ' || p_payment_method);
    DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE(RPAD('Payment Ref ID', 25) || ': ' || v_new_pay_id);
    DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE('---------------------------------------------------');
    
    IF v_voucher_issued THEN
        DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE('>> [ EXCLUSIVE WELCOME PERK ISSUED ] <<');
        DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE('A First-Time Welcome Voucher (' || v_voucher_code || ') has');
        DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE('been automatically added to your wallet.');
    ELSIF v_has_received_welcome > 0 THEN
        DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE('>> [ WELCOME PERK STATUS ] <<');
        DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE('User has previously claimed the First-Time Welcome');
        DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE('Voucher. No new welcome vouchers issued.');
    END IF;
    
    DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE('===================================================');
    DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE('>> DB Status: SUBSCRIPTION and PAYMENT tables updated.');

EXCEPTION
    WHEN e_invalid_payment THEN
        DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE('ERROR: Invalid Payment Method. Must be Credit Card, Debit Card, E-Wallet, or Cash.');
    WHEN e_already_vip THEN
        DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE('ERROR: Transaction Failed. Member ' || p_member_id || ' is already an Active VIP.');
    WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND THEN
        DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE('ERROR: Invalid Member ID or Subscription Plan ID.');
    WHEN OTHERS THEN
        DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE('An unexpected error occurred: ' || SQLERRM);
        ROLLBACK; 
END;
/
